verdict.line: You lose exchanges if Gwen lands Skip 'n Slash before your combo is online, but you win if you chain Rupture into Feral Scream and finish with Feast.

brief.thesis: Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) only blocks targeted spells and autos — it does nothing against Rupture's ground-targeted knockup or Feral Scream's cone silence, so your whole lockdown combo bypasses her one defensive tool. At 53.5% over 155 games this is a real but narrow edge, not a stomp: solo-kill advantage sits with you, but only once you land Q into W instead of reaching for R.

theirWindow.when: Her E Skip 'n Slash is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She dashes in for bonus attack speed, range, and magic on-hit, and hitting you partially refunds the ability — back off or silence her before that first empowered auto lands.

yourWindow.when: Mist and E are both down after a failed all-in
yourWindow.what: Rupture for the knockup and slow, immediately follow with Feral Scream to silence all four of her abilities, then stay in melee stacking Vorpal Spikes until she's dead or forced to flash.

start.why: Run at 58.1% win over 148 games (75.9% pick) — the mana and AP scaling feed your Rupture/Feral Scream poke before the combo comes online at 3-5.

boots.why: 48% win over 100 games (54.1% pick) — magic resist and tenacity directly answer Gwen's magic passive and her slow from R Needlework.

core.why: Stacks raw max HP so Gwen's A Thousand Cuts (%HP magic damage) does proportionally less to you over the lane.
Grievous Wounds directly cuts the self-heal Gwen gets off A Thousand Cuts — this is the single biggest counter to her sustain.
Punishes her auto-reliant Q channel and E empowered autos with reflect damage on top of more Grievous Wounds.

situational.when: you're struggling to stick on her through Skip 'n Slash dashes
the game drags into extended skirmishes and you need omnivamp
her magic burst from Needlework and passive stacking is deleting you
you're ahead and want to snowball damage instead of more tankiness

runes.keystoneWhy: The burst attack speed window lines up with Vorpal Spikes procs during the Rupture-into-Feral Scream lockdown, maximizing stacks while she's silenced and can't fight back.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate at 67.7% — Ignite's Grievous Wounds stacks with Hollow Radiance/Thornmail to shut down her A Thousand Cuts healing during the all-in.

playing.title: Answer Mist with Q, not R
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist blocks single-target spells like Feast and your basic attacks unless you're standing inside it. Rupture's ground-targeted knockup and Feral Scream's cone still land regardless — use those, save Feast for when she's caught outside mist or you're already in it.

playing.title: Chain Rupture into Feral Scream
playing.detail: Land the knockup and slow, then immediately silence with Feral Scream (13s cooldown) to shut down her E dash and Q channel at once during the trade window.

playing.title: Track her E timer
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash drops to as low as an 11s cooldown with ranks — when it's up she gets a dash plus bonus attack speed, range, and on-hit magic damage, and hitting you refunds part of the cooldown.

playing.title: Hold melee range after lockdown
playing.detail: Once she's silenced or slowed, stay in her face and stack Vorpal Spikes on every auto — she has no ability answer while locked down.

playing.title: Pressure through her sustain
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts heals her off the magic damage her attacks deal to you, so finishing Hollow Radiance before extended skirmishes is a direct counter, not just a tank item.

playing.title: Save Feast to finish, not open
playing.detail: Feast's true damage is best spent securing the kill once she's locked down — killing with it grows your max HP up to 6 stacks, snowballing you into the next trade.

playing.title: Trade carefully before level 3
playing.detail: Before you have both Q and W, her Snip Snip cone can out-poke your short-range kit — prioritize last-hitting over extended exchanges until the combo is online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are our own read on the matchup.
